item.title: Show HN: FolderForge, open-source native macOS folder icon designer
item.summary: native SwiftUI app for designing and applying custom macOS folder icons. It supports colors/gradients, SF Symbols, emoji, text and custom images, plus presets and recursive folder-tree styling with exclusions.
